All tests pass. Here's a summary of the 5 bugs fixed in `inventory.py`:

| Bug | Location | Fix |
|-----|----------|-----|
| Mutable default `tags=[]` | `add` method line 19 | Changed to `tags=None` with `tags = list(tags)` to give each item its own copy |
| Item deleted at qty=0 | `remove` method line 41 | Removed `del self.items[sku]` so item stays with qty 0 |
| `low_stock` uses strict `<` | `low_stock` method line 49 | Changed to `<=` so threshold is inclusive |
| `search` only checks name | `search` method line 56 | Added case-insensitive tag matching |
| `page` is 0-indexed | `page` method line 61 | Changed `number * size` to `(number - 1) * size` |

Final pytest summary: **8 passed** (test_inventory.py) + **12 passed** (test_own.py).
